production_like_75_25_switch_forensics.interpretation: The fixed 75% PURE / 25% market rule changed too many market winner decisions and lost those switches 56-75. It is not supported as a globally optimal winner-selection weight.

pure_vs_market_disagreement_forensics.interpretation: Historical PURE disagreement alone is not a viable underdog-override signal. The stronger the market favorite in this sample, the worse an unconditional PURE upset switch generally performed.

chronology_clean_fst_context.interpretation: The season-forward F-ST edge came from selective decision-boundary corrections. It did not historically earn its edge by routinely fading clear market favorites.

research_conclusion: Do not replace fixed 75/25 with another fixed global weight and do not authorize a generic super-team fade. The rational next challenger is a prospectively frozen selective switch/gating model that starts from the incumbent pick and asks whether specific pregame evidence makes the market favorite more likely to be mispriced.
